__ ແລ້ວ: every verb (done already) and every state (ຂາວແລ້ວ white now) is accepted so no verb or describing word is ever an option; person/place too (ລາວແລ້ວ could be heard as 'it's him now'); only nouns such as ນ້ຳ ຂາ ແກ້ວ remain as options and none makes a sentence
